title: Your Benchmark Is an Empirical Measure Over Difficulty
abstract: arXiv:2610.29927v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A benchmark is not merely a collection of test questions; it naturally induces an empirical measure over difficulty. In this work, we develop this measure-based view of benchmark evaluation. This perspective allows us to identify and formalize two central failure modes: measure mismatch, where the benchmark difficulty distribution differs from the intended difficulty distribution, and coverage gaps, where uncovered regions along the difficulty axis prevent benchmarks from detecting meaningful localized training progress. We propose two diagnostic metrics that capture these two failure modes and provide rigorous theoretical guarantees. Empirically, we analyze 25 popular benchmarks spanning 7 domains using carefully estimated item difficulties. translated_title: 你的基准测试是关于难度的经验测度
translated_abstract: 基准测试不仅仅是一组测试题目的集合；它天然地在难度维度上诱导出一个经验测度。在本工作中，我们发展了这种基于测度的基准评估视角。这一视角使我们能够识别并形式化两种核心失效模式：一是测度失配，即基准的难度分布与预期的难度分布不一致；二是覆盖缺口，即难度轴上未被覆盖的区域导致基准无法检测到有意义的局部训练进展。我们提出了两个能够刻画这两种失效模式的诊断指标，并为其提供了严格的理论保证。在实证方面，我们利用精心估计的题目难度，分析了横跨7个领域的25个流行基准。结果表明，许多基准隐式地对某些难度区域赋予了过高权重，因此其排行榜结论应当谨慎解读；另一些基准则在难度轴上留下了大量未被覆盖的区域。
tldr: 本文提出将基准测试视为难度上的经验测度这一新视角，识别并形式化了“测度失配”与“覆盖缺口”两种失效模式，提出两个具有严格理论保证的诊断指标，并对7个领域25个流行基准的分析表明许多基准的难度权重隐式失衡，其排行榜结论需谨慎解读。
en_tdlr: This paper recasts benchmarks as empirical measures over difficulty, formalizes two failure modes—measure mismatch and coverage gaps—proposes two diagnostic metrics with rigorous theoretical guarantees, and empirically shows that many of the 25 analyzed benchmarks implicitly overweight certain difficulty regions, so leaderboard conclusions should be interpreted with caution.
